buyer_guide.title: Buyer Journey: Search to Handshake
buyer_guide.description: Step-by-step verified workflow guide for property seekers.

steps.title: Global Search & Filters
steps.action: Enter desired city or property type in the hero search.

steps.title: Catalog & Neighborhood Intel
steps.action: Filter listings and view spatial map intelligence.

steps.title: Property Detail Exploration
steps.action: Review chapters, verified title documents, and pricing.

steps.title: Initiate Deal or Inquiry
steps.action: Click 'Inquire' or 'Schedule Viewing'.

steps.title: Direct Connect Authorization
steps.action: Authorize 1 Connect to establish private communication.

steps.title: Private Inquiry Workspace
steps.action: Enter the private workspace with the owner or broker.
steps.tip: Coordinate messages and viewing appointments here.

steps.title: Two-Sided Deal Handshake
steps.action: When eligible, co-confirm the transaction milestone.

owner_guide.title: Owner Pipeline: Listing to Handshake
owner_guide.description: Step-by-step verified guide for property owners.

steps.title: Owner Workspace
steps.action: View current property listings and performance metrics.

steps.title: Create Property Listing
steps.action: Configure property details, unit types, pricing, and amenities.
steps.tip: PDF text extraction plus one AI drafting pass; staff verify against the source before publish.

steps.title: Leads & Freshness Intelligence
steps.action: Review active buyer leads and freshness metrics.
steps.tip: Keep listing fresh to rank higher.

steps.title: Review Private Inquiries
steps.action: Respond to buyer inquiries and coordinate viewing details.

steps.title: Two-Sided Deal Handshake
steps.action: Co-confirm two-sided deal closure and transaction milestones.

signal_seeker_guide.title: Stratosphere Signal: Broadcast to Connect
signal_seeker_guide.description: Step-by-step verified workflow for broadcasting space requirements with multi-station catchment radius and anonymous behavioral trust.

steps.title: Enter Stratosphere Altitude
steps.action: Navigate to Stratosphere from the Hero Launchpad or Roles switcher.

steps.title: Explore 3D Spatial Radar
steps.action: Survey active demand beacons and multi-station catchment rings.
steps.tip: Filter by Demand, Supply, or District.

steps.title: Compose Signal & Choose Coverage
steps.action: Click 'POST A SIGNAL', select space type, and specify catchment radius (0.5km to 5.0km).

steps.title: Select Identity & Trust Standing
steps.action: Choose Anonymous (SCOUT-XXXX) to keep private info masked while attaching your verified behavioral score.

steps.title: Broadcast Beacon with 7-Day Refresh
steps.action: Publish your signal; coordinates unlock dynamic radar pulse rings.
steps.tip: 7-day freshness decay keeps the feed fresh.

steps.title: Bilateral Connect Handshake
steps.action: Accredited broker or owner intercepts your demand and initiates a deal proposal.
